title: The Disaster Year: The Republic That Drowned Its Own Country
summary: Tells how the Dutch Republic, attacked at once in sixteen seventy-two by France, England and two German prince-bishoprics, breached its own dikes and covered its land with thirty centimetres of water to halt the French army. The episode ranges from Johan de Witt, lynched in The Hague, to De Ruyter's defence at sea and the rise of William the Third.
